headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available and reports agentic-work results
summary: On Oct. 13, Google said Gemini 4 Argon was globally available through the Gemini API and selected Google products, following a phased trusted-tester release announced Sept. 30. Google lists a 1M-token output limit and introductory API prices of $2/M input and $10/M output tokens through Nov. 30, 2026, then $4/M and $20/M. Google reports internal gains across agentic coding, engineering and scientific workflows; its same-day model card says it cannot rule out biological and cybersecurity capability thresholds or a stealth/situational-awareness threshold, and reports passing 14 of 15 loss-of-control challenges. Google’s Oct. 13 robotics post additionally reports an 87% score on ERQA and shows representative robot-control and simulation workflows; the linked benchmark repository describes 400 questions. Performance and safety results remain company-reported; this review found no independent matched Argon evaluation.
